dialect.detail: ACUCOBOL-GT / AcuCOBOL with TOTEM code generator (Italian ERP/retail system 'Geslux'). Uses ACUCOBOL-specific extensions: HANDLE OF WINDOW, HANDLE OF FONT, HANDLE OF STATUS-BAR, COMP-4, CRT STATUS, SCREEN SECTION with AFTER/BEFORE PROCEDURE, 78-level constants, USAGE IS HANDLE OF FONT SMALL-FONT/DEFAULT-FONT.
evidence: USAGE IS HANDLE OF FONT SMALL-FONT
AFTER PROCEDURE / BEFORE PROCEDURE in SCREEN SECTION

purpose.domain_detail: Italian retail/inventory management system 'Geslux' - table maintenance for stock thresholds (Tabella Scorte = stock table). Manages stock levels, automatic ordering schedules by day of week and month, and related flags for a retail/distribution context.
purpose.summary: This program is a generated ACUCOBOL GUI form for maintaining a 'Scorte' (stock/inventory threshold) table in the Geslux retail management system. It allows users to create, modify, delete and search stock records including minimum stock levels, automatic ordering schedules (by day of week and month), and various operational flags. The code was generated by the TOTEM code generator framework.

notable_features: Generated by TOTEM code generator (Italian COBOL GUI framework)
ACUCOBOL-GT GUI extensions: HANDLE OF WINDOW, HANDLE OF FONT, HANDLE OF STATUS-BAR
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars of a 176KB / 5889-line file. The program is clearly production-grade Italian retail software generated by the TOTEM framework for ACUCOBOL-GT. Italian locale evident from DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, Italian variable names (scorte, descrizione, codice, etc.) and Italian date in DATE-WRITTEN. The 'online-cics' program_type enum is used as the closest match for an interactive GUI program (no actual CICS involved).
